institutionalized_lessons: availability of failed evidence is not equivalent to behavioral utility
failure-family identity is a coverage/blocking variable unless a stronger transferable mediator is identified
completed noisy HOLD results must not be rescued by adding samples/models/threshold changes inside the same confirmatory object
post-outcome mechanism discovery must be development-only and retested prospectively
global lineage lease plus unit-level exactly-once protection is required for continuation
HTTP 429 recovery must be measurement-scoped and may not replay completed updater or heldout units
full outcome embargo remains closed until canonical completion and integrity audit

next_scientific_object_proposal.central_hypothesis: Rejected evidence is useful when the selected failure is counterfactually proximal/diagnostic, and a successful anchor may help the updater distill the local failure-to-repair delta.
next_scientific_object_proposal.name: E2-R17-DIAGNOSTIC-WITNESS-REPAIR

stage_c0.suggested_primary: stream-level exact binomial sign test on positive repaired-minus-WIN effects plus positive mean effect
stage_c0.untouched_substrate: pre-reserved E3 future streams and previously-unsplit B4 heldout complement

stage_m1.stream_selection: one per family by deterministic SHA ordering before new outcomes

stage_m2.candidate_selection: larger M1 mean improvement over WIN between PROXIMAL-FAIL and PROXIMAL-CONTRAST; ties choose PROXIMAL-FAIL
stage_m2.eligibility_gate: positive mean candidate-minus-WIN and positive on at least 4/6 validation streams
